column1: # Everything that should be live in players' resources.db: release/build-content builds it, compares
# it with what players have (the stock resources.db and every patch of release/patches.tsv, mounted
# in order) and packs only the files that differ into the next resources.db.patch_<revision>.
# A content change is a change of its source (an edit list, a pack, a Flash tree) and, for a new
# one, its row here, in the same PR; nothing else. Never assemble a patch folder by hand.
# One row a line, tabs between: <kind> <name> <source> <what>. The kinds go in this order (each
# kind's rows in theirs), which is the order they are laid over one another:
#   base   resources.db.patch_<n>   <its sha256>   a published patch made outside these sources
#          (ported maps, weapons and items), taken as it is. Laid over the stock db in ascending
#          n, the base patches are what everything below starts from. Only a published patch, and
#          only for content no source here makes again.
#   movie  <name>   -   srp-026g/flash/<name> compiled over the graphics of its original (the
#          archive its movie.json names: the stock db or a base row); lobby_menu by
#          client-patches/build_lobby_026g.py. Every tree of srp-026g/flash has a row.
#   pack   <id>@<version>   <sha256 of its pack.json>   a resource-porter content pack, composed
#          over the base and the movies (vostok-port pack patch; the folder
#          $SKHID_PACKS_DIR/<id>-<version>), its icons drawn into the lobby movie built from source.
#          With a base row's name as the source: a record, the pack as it is in that patch.
#          in order, to the files as the rows above leave them ("from" values are the base's).
#          With a base row's name as the source: a record, applied in that patch. Every edit list
# A new pack or edit list: a row at the end of its kind. A retune of an edit list or a movie
# change: no row to add (the source changed). A pack's new version: its row's name and sha256.
